title: Need an explosion of coins collapse animation

posts.author: PersistentDreamerGames
posts.body:
*edit* Hey so I should have disclosed this is for a commercial project, but I can't pay for this at the moment. Ideally I'd like to pay back whomever decides to help if I succeed with a Kickstarter, but I can't guarantee success of course with crowd funding. Or I would be willing to pay after the fact if I make enough in sales to pay the creator back. Since it's not a guaranteed payment, I didn't know if I should leave this here or put in classifieds.
Resource Type: Animation
Maker Format: MV
Makers I Own: MV
Art Style: pixel art
Description: Basically I'm looking for an animation that plays when an enemy dies. I'm trying to do like an explosion of coins, or perhaps a fountain of coins.
I'm considering two different ones, one that's a smaller explosion for regular enemies and a second larger one for bosses. Think winning a casino jackpot every time you kill a boss, just coins everywhere. Pixel art style is kind of what I'm going for.
Reference Images:
Uh since it's an animation hard to do but I'm thinking something similar to when you kill a boss in super Mario RPG where coins everywhere, or maybe like the effect in vampire survivors when you open a treasure chests and coins start flying out .

PersistentDreamerGames said:
the animation is where I'm struggling. I have no idea how to make it look like the coins are bursting out.
Click to expand...
If you have a coin you like the look of, you'd just drag it around in GIMP. Make an image and set up grid lines the size of animation cels.
Drag your coin into the first one. Copy it to the next cel, drag it slightly in one direction, paste a second one going in a different direction. etc.
If someone does make you something, awesome. But that's how you can approach it on your own.

I'm not sure what the issue is - if you play the animation on top of an enemy, doesn't it look like the coins are coming from them? Or do you mean making the coins have something to do with the shape of the enemy sprite? I don't really know what you're wanting without any visual references.
PersistentDreamerGames said:
I also need to figure out a way to make this trigger on collapse, but I think I found a way from SGHarlekin's post in this
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/custom-death-animation-plugin-for-mv.154507
Click to expand...
You can also do the traditional method; do a troop event that gives all enemies an immortal state at the beginning of battle. Then each enemy has a troop event that checks for hp to be <= 0, plays the animation, and removes the immortal state so they die.
You can also do two lines of code with a plugin, using Yanfly's Buffs & States Core, give the death state a Custom Apply Effect that says if the target is an enemy, play this animation.
Anyway, I don't mean to distract from your request
